shapes.description: The full set of structural shapes a target's shape field may name. Every value here must appear on at least one target — that's the actual constraint (see README.md), not enforced by this schema.

packageSpec.description: Exactly what to pass to `snippetcheck check --package`. Usually equal to `package`; pinned (e.g. `chalk@4`) when the shape depends on a specific major version.

docsUrl.description: A real, curl-verified HTTPS URL to raw markdown (llms.txt/llms-full.txt preferred over a bare README when the project publishes one).

shape.description: One of the values in the top-level shapes array.

shapeNote.description: Why this target has this shape — what breaks the naive checker if this shape isn't handled.

verifiedAt.description: When docsUrl was last curl-verified to resolve and the shape claim was last checked against a real install.
